maddeler.e:
تشلوا (form I)
# تَشَلُّوا (tašallū) /ta.ʃal.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of شَلَّ (šalla)
# تَشُلُّوا (tašullū) /ta.ʃul.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of شَلَّ (šalla)
# تُشَلُّوا (tušallū) /tu.ʃal.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of شَلَّ (šalla) and شُلَّ (šulla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
